title: solenostemon paniculatus
intro: Solenostemon paniculatus, commonly known as Coleus, is a tropical plant species native to the Old World tropics. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including the potential to treat fever, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Coleus, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its health-promoting properties and potential therapeutic applications.
